proposed_from.topic: For finite-state, finite-action stationary iid-response SCMs with a known nominal controlled transition law whose positive cells are at least epsilon, fixed factual and alternative policies, an arbitrary observation map, bounded rewards, and a nominal target-policy Poisson solution of span at most B, study the sharp interval of the same unit's conditional counterfactual average reward after a factual record of length T. Prove an explicit C(d,k,epsilon,B)/sqrt(T) upper bound on the expected interval diameter uniformly over the complete compatible canonical-response polytope, without imposing a lower bound on response masses or contraction of every conditional counterfactual kernel. Prove sharpness using the legal full-support binary feedback construction, give attained exact finite response-program endpoints, and provide honest simultaneous confidence-fiber coverage when the nominal transition law is estimated from independent calibration data. Do not claim recordwise shrinkage or apply the result to absorbing targets that violate the Poisson condition. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A conditional Poisson decomposition yields an explicit O(sqrt(log T/T)) whole-class bound; all 28 binary antipodal segments admit a uniform expected-diameter bound of 180/sqrt(T) by endpoint linearity, Abel-Doob arguments, and integrable geometric-Walsh derivative energy; exact checks validate the positive feedback witness, hidden-HMM recursion, and derivative identities. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the root-T martingale-family maximal inequality uniformly over the entire higher-dimensional response polytope; the solved edges do not control arbitrary mixtures. EARLY KILL TEST: Analyze the explicit synchronizer/two-permutation triangle over its full two-dimensional parameter square and either prove a T-independent root-T bound or exhibit a legal T-dependent selection with divergent normalized width; conditional-positivity assumptions do not pass. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/scm_longrecord_counterfactual_ambiguity_rate.md.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest long-record comparator, HaughSingal2026Casino, shows only that in its special casino model the time-homogeneous and time-inhomogeneous \(\mathrm{EWAC}/T\) bounds converge together as \(T\to\infty\). It supplies neither a finite root-\(T\) rate nor a bound uniform over the complete finite-state stationary response-program fiber. The field-level gap is therefore a dimension-explicit finite-\(T\) root-\(T\) expected-diameter bound over that complete fiber under recursive policy feedback, with no response-mass floor or conditional-kernel contraction. The first unresolved proof step is the synchronizer--two-permutation square, which must establish a uniform two-parameter rate or exhibit a horizon-dependent counterselection determining the sharp replacement rate. Only after an affirmative square result is the whole-polytope theorem pursued. The finite canonical endpoint program is supporting infrastructure and not part of the novelty claim.

seed_details.title: Whole-polytope root-\(T\) ambiguity theorem
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Section 3.1, Equation 2; Theorems 4.1--4.3; Appendix D.1; Section 7.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace one-transition linear optimization by a supremum of posterior-normalized Poisson martingales indexed by one response law shared across all dates.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for stationary response SCM, conditional counterfactual average reward, long factual record, and polytope-indexed martingale found no exact target-method match.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from SayedanaCainesMahajan2025 by applying its fixed-kernel Azuma bound uniformly over \(q\).
seed_details.rebuttal: The optimizer depends on the realized record and response masses may vanish; pointwise concentration plus a net incurs \(\sqrt{\log T}\), so uniformization is the new theorem.

seed_details.title: Synchronizer--permutation square rate dichotomy
seed_details.anchor_location: The prior proposal's honest-scope common-response-law boundary and the shared-selector compiler reviews.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Upgrade one-dimensional Abel--Doob control to a two-parameter predictable-scale covering with proved corner integrability.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper located studies the explicit synchronizer--two-permutation recursion as a causal compatibility face.
seed_details.red_team: A two-dimensional face is a hand-picked toy and cannot establish the general result.
seed_details.rebuttal: It is the smallest interior face on which all edge proofs can hold while a record-adaptive interior optimizer could still destroy root-\(T\) control, so it is a decisive falsification test.

seed_details.title: Exact shared-selector endpoints and rectangularity frontier
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Definition 2.3; Theorem 2.4; Proposition 2.5; Theorem 2.8; Appendix A; Conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Preserve one response-mass variable in every repeated factor and characterize when sum-before-max equals datewise rectangular maximization.
seed_details.destination_search: LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP and HaughSingal2023DynamicLatent optimize dynamic counterfactuals, but neither gives an if-and-only-if rectangularity criterion for stationary feedback response laws.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from generic canonical-SCM polynomial optimization.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic decidability does not preserve or exploit repeated stationary selectors and gives no necessary-and-sufficient equality frontier against the published rectangular interval construction.

seed_details.title: Exact simultaneous calibration confidence fiber
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; calibrated projection construction; uniform coverage theorem; conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Invert a simultaneous rowwise multinomial region before counterfactual optimization and use deterministic fiber inclusion at active-face changes.
seed_details.destination_search: The exact transition-law confidence-fiber target is named as future work in LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP, Section 7, and is not delivered by generic calibrated projection.
seed_details.red_team: Coverage is a trivial union-bound wrapper around a partial-identification set.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage alone is supporting, but the explicit all-record, both-endpoint fiber remains valuable when attached to the root-rate kernel and avoids invalid endpoint delta methods at zero masses.

seed_details.title: Reward-relevant observability if-and-only-if frontier
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Sections 2.2 and 3.1--3.4; counterfactual-stability result; Conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace fixed-model posterior merging by separation of reward-relevant response-program equivalence classes across the entire compatible SCM fiber.
seed_details.destination_search: vanHandel2009 and DoucMoulinesRitov2009 concern filter stability within one model, not sharp causal envelopes over observationally equivalent mechanisms.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from classical HMM observability or filter-forgetting theorems.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those theorems compare initial distributions within a fixed signal model and require conditions arbitrary deterministic coarsenings may violate; here the latent object is the causal response coupling and only a reward functional need merge.

seed_details.title: Critical stationarity-drift sensitivity frontier
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Proposition 1; time-homogeneous and time-inhomogeneous endpoint programs; Section 4.3.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace exact stationarity by a total-variation drift budget and derive the critical decay of that budget separating contraction from persistent width.
seed_details.destination_search: The anchor compares the two endpoint classes but does not parameterize intermediate drift or derive a critical horizon-dependent threshold.
seed_details.red_team: A continuity interpolation between the paper's homogeneous and inhomogeneous LPs is routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: Feedback makes the shared-selector objective polynomial rather than datewise linear, and the critical drift scale requires matched constructions rather than continuity alone.

seed_details.title: Sharp leading ambiguity constant in the binary feedback model
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; average-reward Poisson decomposition; martingale central limit theorem; Conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a functional limit for the optimized response-face process, not a central limit theorem for one fixed additive functional.
seed_details.destination_search: No located paper derives a Brownian support-functional limit for optimized same-unit response-coupling ambiguity.
seed_details.red_team: The constant \(1/\sqrt{2\pi}\) follows immediately from a Rademacher central limit theorem.
seed_details.rebuttal: That calculation controls only one pair of mechanisms; identifying the endpoint optimizer and the sharp diameter constant requires a process limit over the full binary polytope.

seed_details.title: Policy-class-uniform counterfactual ambiguity rate
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Section 5 robust counterfactual policy optimization; Section 7.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Add a finite alternative-policy index to the response-polytope martingale process and derive the exact complexity penalty before policy selection.
seed_details.destination_search: Robust counterfactual policy papers optimize rectangular interval MDPs or selected mechanisms, not same-unit stationary-response fibers learned after a factual record.
seed_details.red_team: A finite policy class adds only a union bound and no new causal content.
seed_details.rebuttal: Without the single-policy polytope maximal inequality the union bound is unavailable; even after it, a matching policy-complexity frontier and selection regret would be separate work.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected seed joins four threads. LallyKazemiPaoletti2026RobustCounterfactualMDP proves exact one-step response-coupling bounds in Theorems 4.1--4.3 and constructs an interval CFMDP, but its time-indexed optimization does not analyze one stationary response law after a long record. ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCounterfactual proves finite canonical-SCM completeness in Theorem 2.4 and turns sharp bounds into polynomial programs in Proposition 2.5 and Theorem 2.8, but has no repeated-selector rate theorem. HaughSingal2023DynamicLatent uses time-invariant response distributions for exact terminal-query polynomial bounds after a full latent-state record, but has no average-reward or record-length contraction theorem. SayedanaCainesMahajan2025 derives fixed-kernel average-reward concentration through the Poisson martingale decomposition, but not a polytope-indexed posterior supremum. RakhlinSridharanTewari2015 supplies the general sequential-complexity language but does not evaluate the nonlinear filter class at response-polytope boundaries. HaughSingal2026Casino derives a sharp time-homogeneous LP in Propositions 1--2 and qualitative limiting identification in Section 4.3, but no finite-horizon rate and no recursive alternative-policy feedback. Adjacent selected-mechanism papers OberstSontag2019 and LorberbomJohnsonMaddisonTarlowHazan2021 establish mechanism nonidentification but do not bound the all-mechanism interval. KaidoMolinariStoye2019CalibratedProjection supplies the inference exemplar; vanHandel2009 and DoucMoulinesRitov2009 delimit why fixed-model filter stability does not subsume the causal-envelope question.
